title: Regime-Bound Measurement in Complex Systems: Proxy, Placement, and Validity
description: Formalizes a general, validity-aware measurement framework in which analysis is cartography—mapping outputs on a structured response surface—rather than a single verdict. It introduces five operative concepts (regime, proxy, placement, episenter, compression) and applies them to two domains (cosmology via WP3/R(k,S) and AI evaluation), deriving falsifiable predictions and criteria that distinguish regime-stable claims from locally coherent artifacts.
author: Morten Magnusson

S_hat_z.description: Declared proxy for structural state used in the cosmology case; combines star-formation rate density and gas fraction with a constant offset, explicitly blind to local environments.

R_k_S.description: Response surface mapping scale k and structural state S to observable structure (WP3/R(k,S)); used to analyze regime-dependent behavior.

key_results.main_finding: Across cosmology (WP3/R(k,S)) and AI evaluation, apparent model conflicts are shown to be regime mismatches; proxy choice and observer placement systematically reshape residual structure, supporting a cartographic approach to measurement with explicit falsifiable predictions.
parameters_tested: EFC structural regimes: FLOW / TRANSITION / LATENT
datasets_used: Case 2: AI evaluation metrics and human ratings

sealed_predictions.statement: Residuals at regime boundaries will be systematically larger and less coherent than residuals within regime interiors when analyzed on R(k,S).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Show that boundary and interior residual distributions are indistinguishable across multiple datasets after controlling for noise and sampling.

sealed_predictions.statement: Substituting proxies (e.g., alternative constructions of \hat{S}(z) or swapping AI metrics) will induce structured, directionally consistent drift in fitted parameters or model rankings within the same regime.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Demonstrate no systematic drift beyond statistical noise under controlled proxy substitutions across independent datasets.

sealed_predictions.statement: Shifting the episenter (e.g., z-space vs S-space, or accuracy vs calibration) will reorganize apparent signal and residual structure in predictable ways without changing the raw data.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Show invariance of residual maps and rankings under episenter shifts across distinct analyses.

sealed_predictions.statement: Placement matching (aligning physical, instrument, and interpretive placement) will reduce apparent conflicts between models or measurements.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Provide repeated cases where conflicts persist unchanged after rigorous placement matching and calibration checks.

kill_criteria: KC1: No detectable difference between boundary and interior residual structures under regime-partitioned analyses (R(k,S)) across multiple cosmology datasets.

KC2: Proxy substitutions (including alternative constructions of \hat{S}(z) and swaps between standard AI metrics and human ratings) yield no systematic, reproducible drift beyond noise across independent studies.
KC3: Episenter shifts fail to produce any structured redistribution of signal and residuals; residual maps remain invariant across episenter choices in both domains.
KC4: Placement matching does not reduce conflicts among measurements or model comparisons in repeated, pre-registered tests with adequate power.
KC5: A single undeclared episenter and proxy set are demonstrated to be universally valid across all tested regimes without degradation in fit quality or predictive performance.
abstract: Formalises a general measurement framework where analysis is cartography — mapping outputs as coordinates on a structured response surface — rather than verdict. Five operative concepts (regime, proxy, placement, episenter, compression) applied to cosmological structure analysis (WP3/R(k,S)) and AI evaluation. 13 testable predictions with falsification criteria.
core_thesis: Observed outputs in complex systems are not direct reads of the underlying phenomenon, but regime-conditioned products of proxy choice, instrument logic, observer placement, and interpretive compression.

core_concepts.name: Regime
core_concepts.definition: Bounded domain in parameter space where a consistent set of inferential rules, response functions, and validity criteria holds

core_concepts.name: Proxy
core_concepts.definition: Mediating variable through which a phenomenon is made measurable, with defined visibility and declared blindness
core_concepts.failure_mode: Opacity: treating proxy as direct read
core_concepts.cosmology_example: S-hat(z) = log10(rho_SFR) + log10(f_gas) + C0; blind to local environments
core_concepts.ai_example: BLEU score; blind to semantic adequacy, pragmatic coherence

core_concepts.name: Placement
core_concepts.definition: Observer's operative position across three analytically independent spaces
core_concepts.cosmology_example: CMB (z~1100, power spectrum, FLRW extrapolation) vs SNIa (z<0.1, distance ladder, local calibration)
core_concepts.ai_example: Human rater vs automated metric (different instrument + interpretive placement)

core_concepts.name: Episenter
core_concepts.definition: Weighted set of privileged variables and interpretive choices that determines what appears central and what is pushed to the periphery
core_concepts.cosmology_example: z-space vs S-space: same data, different residual structures
core_concepts.ai_example: Accuracy vs calibration error: different model rankings

core_concepts.name: Compression
core_concepts.definition: Structural reduction inherent in any measurement act: mapping from high-dimensional phenomenon to lower-dimensional output
core_concepts.failure_mode: Neglect: scalar treated as complete representation
core_concepts.cosmology_example: P(k) discards phase information and higher-order correlations
core_concepts.ai_example: Scalar benchmark score discards variance, tail behaviour, failure modes

theses.statement: Proxy creates both visibility and blindness
Measurement placement is a primary question
Analysis of the analysis is part of the analysis
A fragment carries holistic structure under four conditions: structural logic preservation, episenter compatibility, directional consistency, regime compatibility
